criteria.description: Repair validates the recorded worktree symbolic HEAD against the declared coordination branch before any mutation.
criteria.notes: Real-Git regression and independent review passed.

criteria.description: A mismatched or detached symbolic HEAD returns the stable blocked-fix finding before merge and exits through finding aggregation.
criteria.evidence: wrong-branch test snapshots declared, wrong, worktree HEAD, and target refs; all remain unchanged and command exits 1
criteria.notes: The canonical helper maps detached HEAD to the same mismatch path.

criteria.description: Success output is emitted only after the declared coordination ref is re-read and equals the target SHA.
criteria.notes: A simulated postcondition miss returns the stable blocked code and prints no Fast-forwarded message.

criteria.description: A clean, correct-branch, strict-ancestor coordination worktree still fast-forwards normally.

negative_invariants.description: The repair must not switch branches, reset refs, discard changes, or introduce a second symbolic-HEAD parser.
negative_invariants.verification_command: uv run --extra test pytest -q tests/coordination/test_coord_staleness.py -k 'wrong_branch_worktree or declared_ref_postcondition or strict_ancestor_check_staleness'
negative_invariants.evidence: WP01 aggregate diff and reviewer anti-pattern checklist
